audience: developers and finance leads who track OpenRouter spend, keys and model choices

useCases.title: Check the connected key and its recent spend
useCases.text: Read the connected key with its spend, remaining limit and expiry. Then read the activity per endpoint for the last 30 days.

useCases.title: Review credits and API keys
useCases.text: Read the credits bought and used on the account. List the API keys with their usage and limits. These reads may need a management key.

useCases.title: Compare the providers of one model
useCases.text: Read one model with its context length and prices. Then list its provider endpoints with their uptime and latency.

useCases.title: Find models that fit a filter
useCases.text: Search the model catalog with filters for modalities or supported parameters. Count the models by output type.

useCases.title: Look up one past generation
useCases.text: Read the model, provider, tokens, cost and latency of one past generation. Read its stored content when logging is on.
